note: Matched to the ARCHETYPE rows that already carry descriptions -- Bard: 'Technically a weapon. The paperwork classifies them as entertainment.' Institutional deadpan, or a scene with the implication left standing. The silly ones are played straight, which is the only way they work.

entries.title: Arcanist
entries.description: Studies magic as a discipline rather than a gift. Cites sources. Holds firm opinions about people who improvise.

entries.title: Archivist
entries.description: Knows where everything is and what it cost to keep. Guards the collection from fire, damp, and enthusiasm.

entries.title: Astronomer
entries.description: Watches something that will not change within their lifetime and takes notes regardless. Patient past the point most people call reasonable.

entries.title: Barbarian
entries.description: Solves the problem directly. The direct solution is frequently correct and is never the one the council voted for.

entries.title: Corsair
entries.description: Licensed piracy, with paperwork. The letter of marque makes it legal and changes nothing at all about the boarding.

entries.title: Doomcaller
entries.description: Announces what is coming, accurately, to a room that would rather not hear it. Rarely thanked and rarely wrong.

entries.title: Falconer
entries.description: Trains something that could leave at any moment and returns because the arrangement suits it. That is the entire art.

entries.title: Gladiator
entries.description: Fights for an audience that decides the ending. Skill is survival and the crowd is the real opponent.

entries.title: Inventor
entries.description: Builds the thing before establishing whether it should exist. The demonstration usually settles that question one way or the other.

entries.title: Lionheart
entries.description: Stands in front. Not the strongest in the line and reliably the first one into it.

entries.title: Mage
entries.description: Formal training, structured casting, and a working theory. The theory is the reason the results repeat.

entries.title: Mechanist
entries.description: Understands the machine as a system rather than a pile of parts. Repairs the cause instead of the symptom.

entries.title: Ninja
entries.description: Success is measured in absence. Anything a witness saw counts as a partial failure.

entries.title: Runesmith
entries.description: Cuts marks into metal that keep working long after. One bad stroke and the whole piece is decorative.

entries.title: Samurai
entries.description: Bound by a code that costs more than it protects, and follows it precisely for exactly that reason.

entries.title: Sorcerer
entries.description: The power arrived unearned and has to be lived with. No curriculum exists for it and one is badly needed.

entries.title: Soulbinder
entries.description: Negotiates with things that used to be people. Those negotiations are binding on both sides.

entries.title: Spellblade
entries.description: Neither discipline is a hobby. Casts mid-swing and stopped explaining how some years ago.

entries.title: Tidecaller
entries.description: Asks the water for something and is sometimes refused. The refusals are more instructive than the successes.

entries.title: Tinker
entries.description: Improves things that were working fine. About half the improvements hold; the other half are thoroughly documented.

entries.title: Voidwalker
entries.description: Steps through somewhere that is not anywhere and arrives elsewhere. Comes back slightly colder each time.

entries.title: Accordion Bard
entries.description: Chose the instrument nobody else would carry. It is loud, it is heavy, and it fills a room without assistance.

entries.title: Airship Captain
entries.description: Commands something buoyant, fragile, and full of people. Weather is the enemy and the crew is the argument.

entries.title: Astral Warden
entries.description: Patrols the space between places. Whatever is being kept out has never been described in writing.

entries.title: Aztec Priest
entries.description: Keeps a calendar that governs everything and reads the obligations in it correctly. Those obligations are not negotiable.

entries.title: Barbecue Berserker
entries.description: Rage channelled into a twelve-hour cook. The fury is genuine, the timing is exact, and the result is outstanding.

entries.title: Battledancer
entries.description: Fights in a form that reads as choreography right up until it connects. The rhythm is the defense.

entries.title: Bear Shaman
entries.description: Borrows something from the bear and gives something back. The exchange is not symbolic.

entries.title: Beastmaster
entries.description: Commands nothing whatsoever. Asks well, consistently, and has been answered often enough to build a reputation on it.

entries.title: Blood Mage
entries.description: The cost comes out of the caster. That keeps the spell list short and every entry on it serious.

entries.title: Bloodborne Hunter
entries.description: Hunts the thing they are slowly becoming. The clock is internal and nobody else can read it.

entries.title: Brewmaster Monk
entries.description: Discipline, patience, and fermentation. All three take precisely as long as they take.

entries.title: Bubble Mage
entries.description: Everything they make is beautiful, weightless and temporary. They know this. That is the practice.

entries.title: Bubble Rider
entries.description: Travels by something that could pop. Has calculated the risk, accepted it, and is having an excellent time.

entries.title: Candy Wizard
entries.description: Sugar as a functioning magical substrate. The spells work and every one of them is somewhat sticky.

entries.title: Celtic Warden
entries.description: Keeps the old boundaries, the ones marked by stones rather than maps. Knows which fields not to cross.

entries.title: Centaur Archer
entries.description: Fires from a moving platform that is also their legs. The accuracy is unfair and everybody has said so.

entries.title: Chaos Architect
entries.description: Designs systems that fail interestingly. The failure is the specification rather than a defect in it.

entries.title: Cheese Bard
entries.description: Committed entirely to a bit that stopped being a bit years ago. The scholarship is real now.

entries.title: Chocolatier Alchemist
entries.description: Temperature, timing, and transformation. Only one of those three will forgive an error.

entries.title: Chronomancer
entries.description: Moves through time in small, expensive increments. Keeps a ledger of everything already spent.

entries.title: Clockwork Knight
entries.description: Wound each morning and dependable until it runs down. Knows the hour of that and plans around it.

entries.title: Cloud Jumper
entries.description: Crosses the sky by treating it as ground. Whether this works gets decided fresh every time.

entries.title: Codebreaker
entries.description: Sits with the same page for weeks. The answer arrives whole, at an inconvenient hour, and looks obvious afterward.

entries.title: Coral Guardian
entries.description: Defends something that grows at a millimetre a year. Patience is not a virtue here, it is the job description.

entries.title: Crystal Mage
entries.description: Stores power in lattice and draws it back cleanly. The storage is the innovation; spending it is easy.

entries.title: Cultist
entries.description: Belongs to something and has stopped auditing what. The belonging is genuine and covers a great deal of ground.

entries.title: Desert Nomad
entries.description: Carries water, route knowledge, and nothing else. Everything owned has been justified against its own weight.

entries.title: Dragon Rider
entries.description: The dragon consented. That consent is renewed daily and neither party treats it as settled.

entries.title: Dreamweaver
entries.description: Builds inside somebody else's sleep. Leaves before waking and does not always leave nothing behind.

entries.title: Duck Whisperer
entries.description: The ducks listen. Nobody has established why and the ducks are not discussing it.

entries.title: Earth Warden
entries.description: Moves stone slowly and permanently. Every change made will outlast the argument that prompted it.

entries.title: Echo Knight
entries.description: Fights alongside a version of themselves half a second behind. The coordination took years.

entries.title: Elementalist
entries.description: Fluent in all four and master of none, which is a deliberate trade and a deeply unpopular one.

entries.title: Ethereal Assassin
entries.description: Passes through the wall, the guard, and the lock. The approach was never the difficult part.

entries.title: Fairy Tailor
entries.description: Works at a scale requiring instruments nobody sells. Every commission is bespoke out of necessity.

entries.title: Fate Spinner
entries.description: Adjusts the thread by small amounts. Large adjustments are possible and have gone badly enough to stop.

entries.title: Fire Dancer
entries.description: Close enough to burn, deliberately, in time. The margin is the performance.

entries.title: Foxfire Mage
entries.description: Cold light that leads travellers off the path. Insists this is not the intent and has not altered the spell.

entries.title: Gentleman Duelist
entries.description: Impeccable manners and a settled question of honour. The manners are not a softening of the duel.

entries.title: Gravewalker
entries.description: Comfortable where others are not. The dead are consistent company and rarely ask for anything.

entries.title: Harpy Huntress
entries.description: Hunts from above and screams first. The scream is tactical and everyone underestimates it exactly once.

entries.title: Ice Sculptor
entries.description: Makes something extraordinary that is already leaving. Photographs are the only archive there will be.

entries.title: Inflatable Warrior
entries.description: Cannot be cut, cannot be crushed, and can absolutely be popped. Fights accordingly.

entries.title: Kraken Whisperer
entries.description: Maintains a working relationship with something enormous. The relationship is one-sided in a direction nobody expects.

entries.title: Language Bard
entries.description: Wins arguments in whichever tongue disadvantages the opponent. Picks up a new one every port.

entries.title: Lava Surfer
entries.description: Rides something that would end them on contact. The board is the whole technology and it is proprietary.

entries.title: Librarian of Doom
entries.description: The catalogue is complete. Several entries should not be requested and are shelved accordingly.

entries.title: Lightning Striker
entries.description: Arrives before the sound does. The advantage lasts exactly one exchange and is usually enough.

entries.title: Luck Manipulator
entries.description: Adjusts probability slightly and constantly. Nothing is ever provably their doing, which is the entire point.

entries.title: Marionette Master
entries.description: Controls from above by thread. The puppets are excellent and audiences watch the hands regardless.

entries.title: Mathemagician
entries.description: The proof is the spell. An error on line four means something in the room catches fire.

entries.title: Mech Operator
entries.description: Wears a building and moves it like a body. The calibration is personal and cannot be handed over.

entries.title: Medium
entries.description: Relays what is said, including the parts nobody wanted relayed. Accuracy is the only service on offer.

entries.title: Medusa Enchantress
entries.description: The gaze works. Social occasions have been redesigned around this fact from both directions.

entries.title: Merfolk Warrior
entries.description: Fights in three dimensions against opponents thinking in two. The outcome is decided before the first blow.

entries.title: Mime Assassin
entries.description: Silent, precise, and impossible to describe to a witness. Nobody ever believes the report.

entries.title: Minotaur Warrior
entries.description: Built for close quarters and a corridor. Fights where the space favours them and declines to leave it.

entries.title: Mongolian Archer
entries.description: Shoots at full gallop and hits. Practised from an age most people cannot remember reaching.

entries.title: Mushroom Druid
entries.description: Tends a network rather than a garden. What looks like separate organisms is one long conversation.

entries.title: Necromancer
entries.description: Raises the dead and observes the paperwork of it. The ethics are contested; the technique is not.

entries.title: Night Stalker
entries.description: Sees perfectly at the hour everybody else is guessing. The advantage is total and expires at dawn.

entries.title: Occultist
entries.description: Studies what the institutions declined to catalogue. The reading list is short and difficult to obtain.

entries.title: Pastry Chef Mage
entries.description: Precision, heat and structure, cast as spellwork. The whole thing collapses if the fold is wrong.

entries.title: Philosopher
entries.description: Asks the question that unsettles the room, then keeps sitting there. Not trying to be difficult.

entries.title: Pie Archer
entries.description: The trajectory is calculated properly. The projectile is a pie. Both facts are taken entirely seriously.

entries.title: Pillow Fighter
entries.description: Full commitment, no lasting damage, and a rules set everybody agreed to in advance.

entries.title: Pirate Captain
entries.description: Elected by the crew and removable by them. Authority is conditional here and everyone knows the terms.

entries.title: Portal Walker
entries.description: Opens the door and steps through. Closing it behind them is a discipline learned the hard way.

entries.title: Rainbow Archer
entries.description: Every shot leaves a coloured trail, which is beautiful and tactically catastrophic.

entries.title: Reality Bender
entries.description: Adjusts the local rules and hopes they hold. Occasionally something else adjusts back.

entries.title: Rubber Chicken Knight
entries.description: The heraldry is absurd and the swordsmanship is not. Opponents learn these two facts in that order.

entries.title: Rune Scholar
entries.description: Reads the marks rather than cutting them. Has translated several things that were meant to stay sealed.

entries.title: Sailor of the Abyss
entries.description: Crews something that goes down rather than across. The depth is the voyage.

entries.title: Satyr Bard
entries.description: Plays until the room forgets it intended to leave. This has consequences and none of them are surprises.

entries.title: Scorpion Knight
entries.description: Armored, patient, and armed at the back rather than the front. Waits to be approached.

entries.title: Sea Witch
entries.description: Trades in exact terms and honours them exactly. The disappointment is always in what the customer failed to specify.

entries.title: Shadow Monk
entries.description: Discipline practised in darkness until darkness stopped being a limitation. Strikes, and is already elsewhere.

entries.title: Shadowblade
entries.description: Kills from the dark and leaves no scene behind. What separates them from an assassin is that this one likes the dark.

entries.title: Shark Tamer
entries.description: Not tamed, exactly. An understanding, renegotiated in the water, every single time.

entries.title: Snake Charmer
entries.description: The snake is not charmed and is watching the instrument. Both parties know this and continue anyway.

entries.title: Space Marine
entries.description: Drops into hostile atmosphere in armor built for it. Doctrine covers everything, and covers it well.

entries.title: Spaghetti Sorcerer
entries.description: Casts in strands. The spell tangles, the tangle holds, and untangling it later is somebody else's problem.

entries.title: Spider Weaver
entries.description: Builds the structure and then waits inside it. The waiting is the skilled part.

entries.title: Steam Alchemist
entries.description: Pressure, reaction and containment. Two of those are reliable on any given morning.

entries.title: Storm Herald
entries.description: Announces the weather and, on disputed occasions, brings it. Nobody has managed to separate the two.

entries.title: Stormcaller
entries.description: Calls it and then stands inside it. Control is partial and has always been partial.

entries.title: Tea Wizard
entries.description: The infusion is the casting. Timing, temperature and leaf are all load-bearing and none of them may be rushed.

entries.title: Tibetan Monk
entries.description: Trained in a tradition with its own long lineage and its own reasons. Practice is daily and unhurried.

entries.title: Time Traveler
entries.description: Knows how this ends and cannot say so. Every conversation runs on two levels for them and one for you.

entries.title: Toast Wizard
entries.description: Heat applied to bread as a magical discipline. Deeply unserious and technically flawless.

entries.title: Toy Soldier
entries.description: Follows orders given a long time ago by somebody no longer present. Still holding the position.

entries.title: Unicorn Rider
entries.description: Was chosen rather than choosing. The criteria have never been published and cannot be studied for.

entries.title: Viking Berserker
entries.description: Goes somewhere else during the fight and returns afterward. Remembers little and gets told a great deal.

entries.title: Void Mage
entries.description: Casts with absence rather than force. The results are difficult to describe and easy to recognise.

entries.title: Wind Runner
entries.description: Faster than anything on foot has a right to be. Stopping was the part that took longest to learn.

entries.title: Wolf Tamer
entries.description: Joined the pack rather than commanding it. Rank within it is earned and is periodically reviewed.

entries.title: Wraithbinder
entries.description: Ties something restless to a place or an object. The binding holds for as long as the terms are honoured.
